title: Route fragment
description: The external routes of one deployable, which Edge publishes on the application hostname (Edge detailed design, section 03). The upstream of every route is the deployable that ships the fragment. A route has only the four fields below, so a fragment cannot carry anything else; the fields under $defs name the content that section 03 forbids by the fields that would carry it, so that a refusal names the rule.

paths.description: Exact paths, or path prefixes that end in /*.

methods.description: The HTTP methods allowed on those paths.

traffic.description: The traffic class, which selects the limits, timeouts and sizes of section 05. websocket also marks a WebSocket route.

upstreamAddress.description: a fragment cannot name an upstream address: the upstream of its routes is always the deployable that ships it, with its instances from the instances file

plugin.description: a fragment cannot add or configure a plugin

code.description: a fragment cannot contain Lua or a serverless function

pathRewrite.description: a fragment cannot rewrite a path

rawTimeout.description: a fragment cannot set a raw timeout: its traffic class selects the timeouts

rawSize.description: a fragment cannot set a raw size: its traffic class selects the sizes
